goal: Reranking that costs nothing on easy queries — run the cross-encoder only when the top of the ranking is actually contested.

checkboxes.text: `should_rerank(scores, margin)` decides from the top-two gap relative to the pool spread {#M1}
`Topic.ask(rerank=rr, rerank_margin=m)` skips the reranker when the leader is clear, and says so {#M3}
`examples/04_rerank_bench.py` reports MRR, reranker calls and latency for off / auto / always {#M5}
